# the paths that run .github/workflows/security-audit.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow must list the same patterns in the same order
# (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file that can change a job's result is listed: a missing one skips the job on a
# change that alters it (a file a job reads that cannot change the result is not listed,
# e.g. .gitignore, which `cargo package` reads but which cannot change the packed tracked files)
# audit / deny / coverage resolve the dependency graph
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
# every cargo command at the root uses this toolchain
rust-toolchain.toml
# deny: the policy file
deny.toml
# stub-guard greps src/; machete reads the sources for uses; package-integrity packages
# and builds them; coverage compiles them
src/**
# coverage runs the tests
tests/**
# machete walks every Cargo.toml and the sources beside it, the fuzz workspace included
fuzz/Cargo.toml
fuzz/fuzz_targets/**
# package-integrity: the files `cargo package` puts in the .crate (Cargo.toml `readme`,
# the license and notice files); a missing one fails the packaging step
README.md
README_JP.md
CHANGELOG.md
LICENSE-Proprietary
TRADEMARK_NOTICE
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/security-audit.yml
.github/paths/security-audit.txt
